Key learnings
BlockTree was established from the desire to solve the problem when an individual/organization give donations for afforestation but do not know the money they donate is really used for afforestation, or planted the right amount of commitment , or want to know how the trees you donate every year will grow.
Over a year of operation, we have had achievements such as:
- Successfully raised crowdfunding 2 times from Catalyst fund with a total amount of up to 70,000 USD
- Donated 12,500 trees and are continuing to finish planting all the donated trees this year
- NFT and put on Blockchain planted areas
- Building toolsets for Planter (Admin portal & mini-ERP)
- Officially established BlockTree Social Enterprise and have a volunteer account to make the funding source transparent
- Continue to add more talented teams to help BlockTree complete the NFT mission of 1 million forest trees as soon as possible
